what_they_do: Alguna is a pricing, quoting, and billing platform for AI, SaaS, and fintech companies. It replaces the spreadsheets and custom scripts teams normally cobble together to track usage, generate quotes, and invoice customers, letting non-engineers configure usage-based, hybrid, or subscription pricing and handle billing, payments, and revenue recognition in one system instead of stitching together separate tools for each step.
vertical: revenue management / billing and quote-to-cash software
theme_fit_rationale: Alguna's core product is CPQ, usage metering, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition unified into one quote-to-cash workflow, which is an explicit use case under Theme 2 (revenue management: billing, CPQ, quote-to-cash) and sits alongside pipeline comps like Salesbricks. It also has a secondary fit with Theme 3: through its TinyFish Accelerator partnership it is actively building consumption-based, agent-native pricing infrastructure for AI agent builders, aligning with Theme 3's focus on consumption-based pricing for the agent economy.

recent_signals.summary: Alguna sponsored SubscriptionX 2026 in London; CEO Aleks Djekic spoke on a panel about involuntary churn from payment failures.
Alguna joined the TinyFish Accelerator as a billing partner, helping AI agent builders design usage-based, hybrid, and agent-native pricing models.
